description: Adds a Sports library: leagues as shows, seasons, and events as episodes, with release matching through your Ether indexers. Catalogue data from the sportarr.net public metadata service (TheSportsDB data).

indexerCategories.description: Comma-separated Newznab categories searched for events (5000 TV, 5060 TV Sport).
indexerCategories.title: Indexer categories

leagues.default: WWE, UFC, AEW, Boxing, English Premier League, UEFA Champions League, Formula 1, MotoGP, NFL, NBA
leagues.description: Comma-separated league names or TheSportsDB league ids. Each one becomes a show with seasons and events. Promotions with weekly shows (WWE, AEW) are split into one show per programme.
leagues.title: Leagues

seasonsBack.description: How many seasons before the current one to list for every league.
seasonsBack.title: Past seasons to keep

source.description: Where leagues, seasons and events come from. sportarr.net needs no key. TheSportsDB needs the API key below; its free key lists only 15 events per season. Changing this re-creates the events in the library.
source.title: Catalogue source

splitWeeklyShows.description: List weekly programmes such as Raw, SmackDown and NXT as separate shows instead of one league.
splitWeeklyShows.title: Split weekly shows

theSportsDbKey.description: Your TheSportsDB API key, from your profile page on thesportsdb.com. Only used when the source is TheSportsDB.
theSportsDbKey.title: TheSportsDB API key

ether.summary: Leagues, seasons and events for wrestling, combat, football, motorsport and more

name: Sports
